extra.reason: Implemented and verified against a real running docker compose stack: all four services (rng, hasher, webui, worker) expose /healthz, /live, and /metrics returning valid Prometheus text format. worker got a new background HTTP server since it had none before, with real k8coins_hashes_total/k8coins_coins_total counters confirmed incrementing live. Caught and fixed two real bugs during verification: hasher's wrong Ruby module path (formatter vs formats) and worker's Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK probing 'localhost' instead of '127.0.0.1' (same IPv6-resolves-first issue hasher's Dockerfile already documented). Shipped as v0.2.0, CI green. Startup probes deliberately out of scope per the design discussion - no service has authentic slow-start behavior.
